description.summary: Note : This song deals with hero points.
description.value: Note : This song deals with hero points. See Hero Points for full details. Playing a heroic ballad, your target is infused with the luck and fortune of heroes of old. This song grants 1 hero point to the target. This hero point must be spent before the duration expires, or it is lost. The bonus hero point is spent before any other hero points the target might possess. The same target must wait until the end of the encounter or one minute before being affected again, whichever is longer.
